description: google.protobuf.Timestamp on the JSON wire. proto3 JSON parses RFC 3339 on input and emits a Z-normalized string with 0, 3, 6 or 9 fractional digits on output. Input that is not a timestamp is rejected.

vectors.rationale: Baseline. An already-normalized timestamp is unchanged.
Three fractional digits are preserved rather than padded or truncated.
Nanosecond precision survives. An implementation backed by a millisecond clock type silently truncates here.
A zero offset is accepted on input and normalized to Z on output.
Same instant, different offset. Two SDKs that skip normalization produce different bytes for the same moment, which matters wherever bytes are compared rather than instants.
Input that is not RFC 3339 is rejected rather than stored. An SDK that forwards it makes some later peer report the error instead.
A JSON number is not a Timestamp. Coercing it to a string hides the error.
